weekend-plans.summary: Ssali and Nakato talk about last weekend and the next one.
lines: Nakato! What did you do last weekend?
I went to Masaka to visit my mother.
I don’t know. What are you planning?
I’m going to the lake in Entebbe. Are you coming?
Yes! But I don’t have much money.
Don’t worry. We’ll go in my car.
Thank you very much! See you on Saturday.
